name: Pedaiah
overview: Pedaiah is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as being from Rumah. Beyond this geographic detail, little else is recorded about his personal background or tribal affiliation in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Pedaiah means "YHWH ransoms," reflecting a theologically rich meaning centered on God's redeeming work. This proper name is noted in 2 Kings 23:36.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Pedaiah is the father of Zebidah, as stated in 2 Kings 23:36. No other family relationships are documented beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Though not extensively detailed, Pedaiah's mention as the father of Zebidah ties him to the royal lineage, as Zebidah was the mother of King Josiah. His identification as being from Rumah situates him geographically within the biblical narrative, contributing to the historical context of Judah's monarchy.
